profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Capital One

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently working on an unclassified program called High Energy Lasers. Spent the first three
months developing a front-end component in Java. After being deemed capable, was moved onto
the team that handled the more difficult task of tracking targets through computer vision
algorithms. The software sits on an embedded Linux system and is required to fulfill tight timing
constraints. Our team decided to write the software from the ground up in the Rust programming
language. Despite having minimal experience in Rust, within six months, we were able to learn a
brand new language, meet the short deadline, and deliver a working and tested release. Since
then, I have continued to make successful software deliveries for multiple projects on the program.
positions.insights: Rust (Programming Language), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +14 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Spent five years working on a classified program as one of its starting members. The program is coded in Java and is built with a microservice architecture involving Docker and DC/OS. Worked half a year on the main development team, and later moved to the testing team where I wrote and maintained an automated end-to-end test suite. Daily activities included debugging the system through reading source code and logs, investigating regression test failures, and working with developers to test their new features. I am the primary developer of the test suite and on occasion write code for the microservices and test drivers. A few years in, I was promoted to lead on the testing team.
